# lettermint_route (Resource)

Manage a Lettermint route.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lettermint_route" "inbound" {
  project_id             = lettermint_project.application.id
  name                   = "Support"
  route_type             = "inbound"
  inbound_domain         = "support.example.com"
  inbound_spam_threshold = 5
  attachment_delivery    = "url"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Route name.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `route_type` (String) Route type.

### Optional

- `attachment_delivery` (String) Inbound attachment delivery mode.
- `disable_hosted_unsubscribe` (Boolean) Whether hosted unsubscribe injection is disabled.
- `generate_plaintext_fallback` (Boolean) Whether Lettermint generates a plaintext fallback.
- `inbound_domain` (String) Custom inbound domain.
- `inbound_spam_threshold` (Number) Inbound spam threshold.
- `redact_email_content` (Boolean) Whether dashboard email content is redacted.
- `slug` (String) Route slug.
- `suppress_auto_responders` (Boolean) Whether outbound messages suppress auto responders.
- `suppress_disposable_recipients` (Boolean) Whether disposable recipients are suppressed for each message.
- `tls` (String) TLS delivery policy.
- `track_clicks` (Boolean) Whether click tracking is enabled.
- `track_opens` (Boolean) Whether open tracking is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `id` (String) Lettermint resource ID.
- `inbound_address` (String) Generated inbound address.
- `inbound_domain_verified_at` (String) Inbound domain verification time.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default route.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import lettermint_route.inbound 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
